repo_conventions_hard_rules: Every new .ts/.tsx/.js/.jsx source file needs an Apache 2.0 header with the current year; never bump the year on existing files.
Published changes under /packages or /plugins need changeset coverage in .changeset/*.md; inspect and edit those files directly, never via the changeset CLI.
Breaking change => minor for <1.0.0 packages, major for >=1.0.0. New feature => minor for >=1.0.0, patch for <1.0.0.
Match the style of the individual package being edited; per-package consistency beats repo-wide consistency.
Prefer fewer thorough tests with multiple assertions; use screen and findBy* in React Testing Library; do not add test IDs to implementation.
Behavior changes need docs — TSDoc, package README, or /docs (feature guides belong in /docs, not READMEs).
Run yarn build:api-reports before a PR touching a workspace package's public API.
Never run yarn build / changesets version / yarn release.
